guide.description: The default real voice, or null: the synth plays.

versions.description: Every published version of this part, the default first, then the newest: a learner may choose any as their guide. Empty for a song the caller can't start.

shape.description: The part's coarse shape for Home's song covers (web/js/song-shape.js's rules): one `[start, end, lean]` (three integers) a phrase, in time order, at most 24. start and end are 0 to 1000 of the song's span; lean is the phrase's height against the part's middle, -6 to 6 semitones. No notes, no words; [] when the part has no notes.

title: One part of a song in the catalogue: never its notes
